episodeTitle.en: How we built Grok Bot in a month | Roman Ugarte (SpaceXAI)
episodeTitle.zh: 我们如何在一个月内做出 Grok Bot｜SpaceXAI 的 Roman Ugarte

guestBioOfficial.zh: Roman Ugarte 是 Cursor 的早期员工，做过增长，后来参与孵化 Grok Bot 并负责其产品。他从少数内部用户开始观察，尤其关心大家愿意交给智能体哪些任务，以及在哪些环节仍想亲自掌握进度。
guestBioOfficial.en: An early Cursor employee with a growth background, Roman helped incubate Grok Bot and leads product for it. He pays particular attention to what users delegate and how much of an agent’s progress they actually want to see.

title.en: How we built Grok Bot in a month | Roman Ugarte (SpaceXAI)
title.zh: 我们如何在一个月内做出 Grok Bot｜SpaceXAI 的 Roman Ugarte

summary.zh: 一个小团队用四周做出内部能用的 Grok Bot。Roman 复盘早期用户想看多少执行过程，又把问题从个人扩展到公司：当不同的人共享工具、历史和上下文，怎样判断机器人应该记住什么？
summary.en: A small team took Grok Bot to an internal product in four weeks. Roman looks at how much work users want to observe, then at what changes when tools, context, and memory belong to a whole organization.

insights.title: 执行得越多，越要挑哪些细节值得展示
insights.detail: 早期试用时，团队观察用户想看多少过程。Roman 用同事作比：你通常需要了解进展，但不会要求对方逐秒汇报按了哪个按钮。
insights.detailEn: Early onboarding revealed that people wanted visibility without a second-by-second account of every button their agent pressed.

insights.title: 共享记忆不是把个人记忆扩大一圈
insights.detail: 公司系统牵涉多人和历史决定。Roman 把「团队里的机器人需要知道什么」列成独立问题，而没有假定个人助手的做法可以直接复用。
insights.detailEn: A bot inside a company needs to handle shared systems and history. Organizational memory raises questions that individual memory does not.
insights.titleEn: Shared memory needs its own design

insights.title: 早期先验证产品，再推演遥远的护城河
insights.detail: 回看 Cursor，Roman 怀疑从两年后的战略位置倒推出发，是否会做出同一个产品。新需求变化得快，眼前的用户反馈更有辨别力。
insights.detailEn: Looking back at Cursor, Roman doubts that working backward from a hypothetical two-year moat would have produced the same product.
insights.titleEn: Test demand before predicting a moat
